title: The Try this card: one design for every chapter
tries: The card that replaces 'Do this now' (the editor's briefs 10 and 12; the storyteller's 118 and the cast guide's page conventions, item 1): an accent band, a label with a small mark, and three labelled lines, the idea, what I would try first, what it gives you. Set in CSS (lab/tools/book/try-this.css) so the publisher places it in all the chapters from the chapter's own words; shown here at the book's size, on a plain page and beside a words box.
made_from: sample words for the look only, from chapter 1's 'Do this now' (manuscript/rc2/150/01, read only); the writer's lines replace them
question: Does it read as the chapter's take-home, visible but not aggressive?
